facts.text: Cedric's signed promissory note obliges him to pay the party 975 gold (three-quarters price) for the barrow treasure once the caravans flow again. Sir Phidipaldi has pledged the note to recruit Malzazarik and Lady Hilda.
facts.uncertain_reason: Unclear whether the party still holds the note or has handed it, or its proceeds, to Malzazarik and Lady Hilda.
